svg.title: PPO actor-critic learning on the C-MPC decision tree
svg.desc: Left: the decision tree used by exact search serves as the RL environment; a PPO episode follows one feasible branch per decision node from root to leaf, with branch probabilities from the actor and a value estimate of the remaining subtree from the critic. Right: the actor scores each feasible branch with robot-wise shared networks and a softmax over the variable number of branches; the critic maps the state to a value.
svg.text: Exact search expands every branch. PPO follows one branch per decision node.
Policy: actor–critic at a decision node
Works for any number of robots and feasible branches.

text.tspan: Episodes are rolled out on the tree, and
are updated with standard PPO (clipped objective, GAE).
+ const, so maximizing return minimizes the co-design objective; the pending-delay term
